extraction.extraction_notes: Company name appears as 'Canna Farm' on slide 5 and 'CannaFarm' on slide 7; treated as the same entity. No ticker stated — company appears to be private and pre-revenue (still in fundraising/startup stage). No CIK stated. Website shown is cannabusinessplan.com (slide 16); contact email is info@cannabusiness.com. No fiscal year end is stated. Revenue projections on slide 14 are labeled Year 1/2/3 with no absolute calendar years anchored, making them difficult to cross-reference without knowing when operations begin. The $330,000 investment figure on slide 15 line items sum to $253,000, which does not match the stated $330,000 total — a potential arithmetic discrepancy the compliance agent should flag. The 28% CAGR and $22.8B market size claims are attributed to unnamed 'expert projections' with no cited source. No historical financial data (revenue, burn, ARR) is provided. Regulatory licensing status of Canna Farm itself is not disclosed; the licensed business counts shown are for the broader California market, not the company's own licenses. Team bios and credentials are entirely absent.
